description: Turn offers and counter-offers on or off for your workspace and set the schedule every negotiation runs on. Omitted fields keep their saved value, or the default. A handle another workspace holds is refused. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

concession_rate.description: How far each counter moves toward the buyer, between 0 and 1.

enabled.description: Whether buyers can make offers to your workspace at all. Off by default.

handle.description: Your public handle: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

max_rounds.description: Most offers a buyer may make in one negotiation.

min_offer_ratio.description: Offers below this share of the list price are rejected outright.

offer_ttl_minutes.description: How long a counter stands before it expires, in minutes.

name: set_offer_settings
